WorldOption.sav support incorporates portions of
[Bluefissure/pal-conf](https://github.com/Bluefissure/pal-conf) at commit
`a0f75513a99684922b0ad58692304f8ddfcc06d3`.

Included components:

- World-option entry metadata and Simplified Chinese labels
- The bundled `uesave` WebAssembly serializer/deserializer and JavaScript glue
